1. Preparation of standard sodium thiosulfate (Na2S2O3) aqueous solution 0.1 M of Na2S2O3 aqueous solution is prepared by dissolving 6.25 g of Na2S2O3 ·5H2O and 5 g of sodium carbonate (Na2CO3) in 250 mL of distilled water.
The real concentration of Na2S2O3 aqueous solution was determined by internal standard method with K2Cr2O7 solution. 61
Titration of oxygen in the as-synthesized material

Firstly, 0.1 g of powder sample was dissolved in HCl diluted solution before the iodometric titration under the protection of nitrogen atmosphere. Then, starch solutions and buffered solution were added and the solution changed to dark blue.
Na2S2O3 aqueous solution was slowly titrated into the solution till the color disappeared. The oxygen non-stoichiometry was then calculated based on the amount of Na2S2O3 aqueous solution.
